shared_elements: low-relief carving on a stone surface
justification: Both surfaces depict human figures in low relief and each includes a circular disc element (the chariot wheel in A, the ring on the torso in B), but that is a generic coincidence. A is a horizontal narrative scene of archers in a chariot with a horse team hunting a lion, rendered with detailed profile figures and animals, while B is a frontal, standing, blocky anthropomorphic figure with a head, arms and schematic ornaments on the body, with no animals, no action and no narrative organisation.
